calculation.description: Negative recent signed intraday close-location pressure, scaled by trailing 20-session return volatility. Uses only completed daily OHLC bars and ranks the available 15 tradable benchmark instruments cross-sectionally.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR passed benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Regime daily IC: 2020-22 0.053755 (ICIR 0.160591), 2023-24 0.026999 (ICIR 0.078545, below ICIR gate), 2025-26 0.054110 (ICIR 0.167209). Short-horizon effect weakens materially by 5-10 sessions; interpret small cross-section conservatively.
